propositions: Gates accept [operator-attested] evidence on trust by design (ADR-0043) without auditing the measurement context in which the evidence was obtained, allowing claims whose measurement could not have failed for the reason claimed (e.g., testing under overprivileged identity or wrong AWS account).

An attestation lacking recorded measurement provenance (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument type) is structurally unverifiable because the evidence's ability to have come out differently cannot be established from the record alone.

Deterministic enforcement of measurement provenance fields as required text in [operator-attested] criteria records the context as repo-checkable material, converting unobservable world-measurement gaps into auditable contradictions between plan claims and IaC declarations.

Privilege posture alone cannot distinguish a policy simulator from a live call (both can declare production-equivalent privilege), so instrument type must be captured as a separate required field to expose simulators that answer the named question rather than the question that mattered.

Criteria judging provenance declarations against repo facts (plan attests account X, IaC names account Y) should ship advisory first per ADR-0054 and measure impact distribution before promotion to blocking posture.
